items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: This is what made this guy Pat Boone so great.

ctx.x: This is what made this guy Pat Boone so great. He stole the exact same arrangement that I had written for Ivory Joe Hunter.

As you go down telling me all these different people you worked with, if you could think of -- if you can think of any particular tune you wrote for so and so, pick any particular tune, just mention it.
